title: The zone file parser in the hickory-proto crate of Hickory DNS 0.24.0 before 0.26.2 panics when a… (CVE-2026-123574)
description: A vulnerability in the zone file parser of the hickory-proto crate in Hickory DNS versions 0.24.0 up to but not including 0.26.2 causes the parser to panic when processing a single token of 4096 bytes or longer. This can be exploited by attackers supplying crafted zone files to trigger a denial of service.
